summary: Final freeze re-verification of Dashboard mobile overflow at 375x812. Logged in as test@songright.com via [data-testid=auth-submit-login], navigated to /dashboard, measured document.documentElement.scrollWidth=375 and window.innerWidth=375. PASS criterion met (scrollWidth <= 400). Regression smoke: no ErrorBoundary, all 6 chapter sections render (Life of a Song, Writing Rooms, Active Sessions, Creative Evidence + Intelligence, Passport + Release Path, Finalized works).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard mobile overflow fix (min-w-0 on lg:col-span-2 grid children at Dashboard.jsx L177/180/189/192) is confirmed effective. scrollWidth measured at exactly 375 (== innerWidth) at 375x812 viewport. Some absolutely-positioned decorative divs extend beyond viewport (e.g., 1200px glow blur, timeline decoration at right=788) but they are inside `overflow-hidden` containers so document scrollWidth remains 375. FREEZE is GREEN.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous iteration_5 showed scrollWidth=484 due to lg:col-span-2 grid items expanding to intrinsic content width on mobile because their min-content > viewport. Adding min-w-0 to the flex/grid children allowed them to shrink below their content min-width, letting inner truncation/overflow-hidden take effect and constraining document scrollWidth to the 375px viewport.
